content.text:
No invoices need finance review under BR-004. That rule flags invoices over USD 500,000, converted at the exchange rate on the invoice date, plus any invoice that can't be assessed. Nothing meets either condition, so 0 invoices are flagged. The data is a snapshot as of 2025-06-30.

The three largest invoices are all well below the limit:

| Invoice | Vendor | Amount | % of USD 500,000 limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| ORA-INV-50008 | National Insurance Brokers | USD 125,000 | 25% |
| INV-2025-0010 | Pacific Raw Materials | USD 92,000 | 18.4% |
| ORA-INV-50009 | Summit Energy Corp | USD 71,200 | 14.2% |

The check covers invoices in all source systems in the AP dataset, including the ORA-INV invoices.
